swayable.summary: The video argues that ordinary people are responsible for higher energy prices because their use of digital products drives demand for data centers. It uses a conversational, self-critical tone to shift blame from Jon Husted onto consumers.
swayable.title: Husted Built the Data Centers. Now He's Blaming You.

traits.change: Open with a new line like: 'As a veteran who served this country, I know when someone is passing the buck — and Jon Husted is passing it to you.'

traits.quote: Jon Husted spent years bringing data centers to Ohio. Now, he's blaming us for higher energy prices.
traits.change: The title sets up the contrast but the script body drops it; add a line like: 'Husted recruited these data centers — now he says look in the mirror.'
The script reads like an unpolished, off-the-cuff recording; re-record with a clean single take, removing all the false starts like 'And And' and 'to to uh the the the.'

traits.quote: you can go back to the bunny ear antenna on your TV
traits.change: This is already strong; if you want to drop it, replace the bunny-ear line with a more formal policy statement like: 'Consumers did not set Ohio's energy infrastructure policy — Jon Husted did.'
The messenger is not identified; if you want this trait, add an intro line like: 'I'm [name], and I served in the Ohio legislature — I watched Husted court these data centers himself.'
Add a line like: 'I remember when Husted came to my county promising jobs from these data centers — he never mentioned our electric bills would go up.'
Add a closing line like: 'Vote for [candidate] — someone who won't blame you for the mess they made.'
The tone is flat and self-critical; to add enthusiasm, replace 'we are the problem' with: 'We have the power to hold Husted accountable — and that starts at the ballot box.'

traits.quote: if you're connected to a wire, you're using a data center
traits.change: This is a broad claim stated as fact; to drop it, cut this line and replace with: 'Husted made the policy choices that brought these data centers here — that is the fact.'
Add a line from a named Ohio resident like: 'My electric bill went up forty dollars a month — Jon Husted should answer for that, not me.'
Add a closing line like: 'Ohioans are proud people — we deserve leaders who take responsibility instead of pointing fingers at us.'
Add a line like: 'Husted personally recruited over a dozen data center companies to Ohio while he was Secretary of State — most voters don't know that.'

traits.quote: you can go back to the bunny ear antenna on your TV
traits.change: To drop the humor, cut the bunny-ear line and replace with: 'Every Ohio household that uses the internet is now being told they caused this problem — that is not leadership.'
To add this trait, have a well-known Ohio public figure open with: 'I'm [name], and I've watched Jon Husted take credit for Ohio's tech growth while sending the bill to you.'
Add a line like: 'It is outrageous that the man who spent years recruiting these companies is now telling Ohio families they are the problem.'

traits.quote: And And if we don't want them, then don't use them. I mean, you can You can go back to to uh the the the
traits.change: The repeated words and filler sounds make it feel unscripted; to make it sound scripted, re-record a clean single take with no false starts or filler words.
Add a line from a named Ohio voter like: 'I supported bringing tech jobs here, but I never agreed to pay higher energy bills so Jon Husted could look good.'
Add a line like: 'As Ohio's Secretary of State and Lieutenant Governor, Jon Husted backed policies that gave data centers tax breaks while passing energy costs to Ohio ratepayers.'
Add a closing line like: 'Ohio can have a tech economy and fair energy prices — but only with leaders who are honest about the trade-offs.'
To drop the negative tone, cut 'we are the problem' and replace with: 'The problem is a politician who made these deals and now refuses to own the consequences.'

traits.quote: And And if we don't want them, then don't use them. I mean, you can You can go back to to uh
traits.change: To drop the amateur feel, re-record the script in a single clean take with no repeated words, filler sounds, or stumbles.
Add an on-screen text line like: 'Source: Ohio Development Services Agency, 2019–2023 data center recruitment records.'
Add on-screen text showing: 'Jon Husted recruited data centers to Ohio for years — now he says you are the problem.'

traits.quote: We, the people, have created the demand for these data centers
traits.change: To drop this trait, cut 'We, the people' framing and replace with a named individual opening: 'I'm [name] from Columbus, and I'm tired of being blamed for Jon Husted's decisions.'

traits.quote: when we look in the mirror, we are the problem
traits.change: To drop this opinion, cut 'we are the problem' and replace with a factual close: 'Jon Husted made the policy — voters should know that before November.'
Add a line like: 'Ohio families are quietly paying more on their electric bills every month, and most of them have no idea why.'
Add a line like: 'If Husted keeps making deals like this, your energy bill will keep climbing — and he will keep pointing at you.'
To add animation, open with a short animated graphic showing Ohio's map with data centers popping up one by one while the words 'Husted recruited these' appear on screen.
